sources.evidence_extract: CSD18543Q3A 60 V N-channel NexFET, SON 3.3x3.3, SLPS633 December 2016 initial release (revision *): pins 1-3 S, 4 G, 5-8 D, exposed pad D. Abs max TA 25 C: VDS 60 V, VGS +/-20 V. 5.1 EC TA 25 C (min/typ/max): BVDSS 60 V min (VGS 0 V, ID 250 uA); IDSS 1 uA max (VDS 48 V); IGSS 100 nA max (VGS 20 V); VGS(th) 1.5/2.0/2.7 V (VDS = VGS, ID 250 uA); RDS(on) 12.0/15.6 mOhm at VGS 4.5 V and 8.1/9.9 mOhm at VGS 10 V, ID 12 A; gfs 40 S typ only (VDS 6 V, ID 12 A). Dynamic, VGS 0 V, VDS 30 V, f 1 MHz: Ciss 885/1150 pF; Coss 168/218 pF; Crss 4.8/6.2 pF; RG 0.5/1.0 Ohm. VDS 30 V, ID 12 A: Qg(4.5 V) 5.6/7.3 nC; Qg(10 V) 11.1/14.5 nC; Qgd 1.7 nC typ only; Qgs 3.1 nC typ; Qg(th) 2.0 nC typ; Qoss 24 nC typ. Diode: VSD 0.8/1.0 V at ISD 12 A. No MIN/MAX for gfs or Qgd. 5.3 typical curves include Fig 3 transfer (VDS 5 V) and Fig 5 capacitance vs VDS.
